2607	    def _rate_limit_alerts(
2608	        attempts: list[_RateLimitAttempt], policy: _RateLimitPolicy
2609	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
2610	        """Group attempts into fixed windows and flag groups over the limit.
2611	
2612	        Groups key on the normalized target and the window start, plus the
2613	        case-sensitive route when the policy groups by target_route. Only a
2614	        group whose total exceeds max_requests alerts; the kind is
2615	        distributed_bypass when at least two identities share the group and
2616	        no single identity exceeds the limit on its own.
2617	        """
2618	        target_pos: dict[str, int] = {}
2619	        route_pos: dict[str, int] = {}
2620	        groups: dict[tuple[Any, ...], list[int]] = {}
2621	        for index, attempt in enumerate(attempts):
2622	            target_pos.setdefault(attempt.target.text, index)
2623	            route_pos.setdefault(attempt.route, index)
2624	            window_start = (
2625	                attempt.timestamp_ms // policy.window_ms
2626	            ) * policy.window_ms
2627	            if policy.group_by == "target_route":

2629	                    attempt.target.text,

2679	    def schedule_requests(self, payload: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
2680	        """Compute the earliest compliant execution time for pending requests.
2681	
2682	        Pure, local evaluation: no network access, no request dispatch, no
2683	        payload execution, and no persistent state. All structure is
2684	        validated first (including duplicate ids, unknown or duplicate
2685	        dependencies, self-dependencies, and dependency cycles); only then
2686	        are request targets checked against the allow/deny scope. Raises
2687	        ValueError on malformed input and ScopeViolationError when any target
2688	        is out of scope; never returns a partial schedule. The same input
2689	        always produces the same schedule.
2690	        """
2691	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
2692	            raise ValueError("payload must be an object")
2693	        required = {"allow", "deny", "policy", "requests"}
2694	        keys = set(payload)
2695	        missing = required - keys
2696	        if missing:
2697	            raise ValueError(f"missing field: {sorted(missing)[0]}")
2698	        extra = keys - required
2699	        if extra:
2700	            raise ValueError(f"unknown field: {sorted(extra)[0]}")

2736	    @staticmethod
2737	    def _resolve_request_order(
2738	        requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
2739	    ) -> list[_ScheduledRequest]:
2740	        """Topologically order requests; same level keeps input order.
2741	
2742	        Raises ValueError on self-references, unknown ids, or cycles.
2743	        """
2744	        known = {request.id for request in requests}
2745	        for request in requests:
2746	            for dep in request.depends_on:
2747	                if dep == request.id:
2748	                    raise ValueError(
2749	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on itself"
2750	                    )
2751	                if dep not in known:
2752	                    raise ValueError(
2753	                        f"request {request.id!r} depends on unknown id: "
2754	                        f"{dep!r}"
2755	                    )
2756	        remaining = list(requests)
2757	        done: set[str] = set()
2758	        ordered: list[_ScheduledRequest] = []
2759	        while remaining:
2760	            ready_now = [
2761	                request
2762	                for request in remaining
2763	                if all(dep in done for dep in request.depends_on)
2764	            ]
2765	            if not ready_now:
2766	                raise ValueError("request dependencies form a cycle")
2767	            for request in ready_now:
2768	                done.add(request.id)
2769	            ordered.extend(ready_now)
2770	            remaining = [
2771	                request for request in remaining if request.id not in done
2772	            ]
2773	        return ordered

2775	    @staticmethod
2776	    def _build_schedule(
2777	        ordered_requests: list[_ScheduledRequest],
2778	        policy: _RateLimitPolicy,
2779	        input_positions: dict[str, int],
2780	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
2781	        """Place each request into the earliest non-saturated fixed window.
2782	
2783	        Candidates are walked in stable topological order, so input position
2784	        decides every occupancy tie. Per group, each fixed window holds at
2785	        most max_requests placements; a full window pushes the request to
2786	        the next window start.
2787	        """
2788	        window_ms = policy.window_ms
2789	        max_requests = policy.max_requests
2790	        scheduled_at: dict[str, int] = {}
2791	        # group -> {window_start: [request id, ...]} in placement order.
2792	        occupancy: dict[Any, dict[int, list[str]]] = {}
2793	        results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
2794	
2795	        for request in ordered_requests:
2796	            candidate = request.earliest_ms
2797	            for dep in request.depends_on:
2798	                if scheduled_at[dep] > candidate:
2799	                    candidate = scheduled_at[dep]
2800	            group: Any
2801	            if policy.group_by == "target_route":
2802	                group = (request.target.text, request.route)
2803	            else:
2804	                group = request.target.text
2805	            group_windows = occupancy.setdefault(group, {})
2806	            window_start = (candidate // window_ms) * window_ms
2807	            candidate_window = window_start
2808	            while len(group_windows.get(window_start, ())) >= max_requests:
2809	                window_start += window_ms
2810	            group_windows.setdefault(window_start, []).append(request.id)
2811	            # Room in the candidate's own window: execute at the candidate
2812	            # time; a bumped request executes at the next window start.
2813	            scheduled_ms = (
2814	                candidate if window_start == candidate_window else window_start
2815	            )
2816	            scheduled_at[request.id] = scheduled_ms
2817	            results.append(
2818	                {
2819	                    "id": request.id,
2820	                    "target": request.target.text,
2821	                    "route": request.route,
2822	                    "scheduled_ms": scheduled_ms,
2823	                    "window_start_ms": window_start,
2824	                    "depends_on": list(request.depends_on),
2825	                    "_pos": input_positions[request.id],
2826	                }
2827	            )

2874	    def _evaluate_safety(
2875	        actions: list[_SafetyAction], policy: _SafetyPolicy
2876	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
2877	        """Decide actions in input order against the safety policy.
2878	
2879	        A disabled policy blocks everything with emergency_stop; otherwise a
2880	        blocked kind is rejected before quota accounting. Remaining actions
2881	        consume one slot of their normalized target's fixed window; the first
2882	        max_actions_per_target per target per window pass, the rest are
2883	        blocked with action_limit. emergency_stop and blocked_kind decisions

2887	        occupancy: dict[tuple[str, int], int] = {}

2889	        for action in actions:

content.content:
1	# RedForge
2	
3	这是一个面向渗透测试与攻防演练的渗透测试与攻防演练平台。长期目标是提供资产发现与指纹识别、端口与服务测绘、漏洞模板匹配、凭证探测、载荷生成、攻击链编排、授权边界强制和结果评分，把攻防演练沉淀为可复用平台。
4	
5	仓库采用 Python，当前冻结基线只提供进程健康检查。后续能力必须通过独立题目逐步实现；每个题目都应定义可观察的公共行为、兼容边界和失败语义，不得依赖未公开内部 API。
6	
7	## 启动
8	
9	```bash
10	PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m redforge.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
11	```
12	
13	服务默认监听 `127.0.0.1:8080`，可通过 `REDFORGE_ADDR` 修改。`GET /healthz` 返回 JSON 健康状态。
14	
15	## 接口
16	
17	- `POST /v1/scope/evaluate`：以 `allow`/`deny` 规则评估 `targets` 的授权范围，纯本地判定。
18	- `POST /v1/vulnerabilities/match`：离线漏洞模板匹配。请求体含 `allow`、`deny`、`templates`、`observations`；
19	  先对全部观察目标执行范围评估（任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`），再把每个观察与每个模板按
20	  `all`/`any` 逻辑匹配，响应仅含 `findings`（按观察顺序、再按模板顺序），每项给出 `observation_id`、
21	  规范化 `target`、`template_id`、`name`、`severity` 和命中匹配器下标 `evidence`。
22	- `POST /v1/assets/fingerprint`：在本地把端口观测识别为服务资产，不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、
23	  `deny`、`fingerprints`、`observations`，后两项可为空数组；`observations` 的每项仅含 `id`（唯一非空字符串）、
24	  `target`（沿用既有目标语法，不得为通配符）、`port`（1–65535 的非布尔整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或
25	  `udp`）、`banner`（字符串）。`fingerprints` 的每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、非空 `name` 和 `service`、非布尔整数
26	  `priority`、值为 `all` 或 `any` 的 `logic`、非空 `matchers`。匹配器只能三选一：仅含 `ports`（无重复的
27	  1–65535 非布尔整数非空数组）、仅含 `transport`（`tcp` 或 `udp`），或仅含 `operator` 与非空 `value`（针对
28	  `banner`，operator 仅限 `equals`、`contains`、`regex`）；文本比较区分大小写，`regex` 使用搜索语义，非法
29	  表达式令请求无效。先完成全部结构校验（结构错误、重复 `id`、或规范化 `target`+`transport`+`port` 相同的重复
30	  端点均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个观测的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403
31	  `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。通过后按 `all`（全部匹配器命中）/`any`（至少一个命中）判定指纹命中，
32	  多指纹命中时选择 `priority` 最大者，并列选择输入靠前者；evidence 为命中匹配器下标，按下标升序返回。成功响应
33	  仅含 `assets`：按目标首次出现顺序分组，每项含规范化 `target` 和 `services`；services 保持观测顺序，每项含
34	  `observation_id`、`port`、`transport`、`service`、`fingerprint_id`、`name`、`evidence`。未命中任何指纹时
35	  `service` 为 `"unknown"`，`fingerprint_id` 与 `name` 为 `null`，`evidence` 为空数组；空 `observations`
36	  返回空 `assets`；相同输入内容与顺序产生稳定结果。
37	- `POST /v1/findings/consolidate`：汇总多次扫描的匹配结果，纯本地处理。请求体含 `allow`、`deny` 和非空
38	  `runs`；每个 run 有唯一非空 `id`、0–100 的整数 `reliability` 和 `findings`（字段与
39	  `/v1/vulnerabilities/match` 的单项一致，拒绝未知字段）。先对全部 finding 的 `target` 执行范围评估，
40	  任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`；随后以规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id` 为键去重，
41	  按首次出现顺序返回 `consolidated`：保留首次出现的 `name`（同键不同 name 为 400），`severity` 取最高者，
42	  `observation_ids` 与 `sources`（run id）各自按首次出现顺序去重，`evidence` 合并为升序去重的非负整数；
43	  `confidence` 对包含该键的每个不同 run 按 runs 顺序计算
44	  `c = c + floor((100 - c) * reliability / 100)`（c 从 0 开始），同一 run 内的重复 finding 只计一次
45	  置信度，但仍参与观察编号与证据合并。没有 finding 时返回空数组；结构错误一律 400 `invalid_request`。
46	- `POST /v1/findings/retest`：把一次复测与既有汇总结果比较，纯本地处理。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、
47	  `baseline`、`retest_runs`；`baseline` 是既有 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 同形数组（可为空），
48	  `retest_runs` 是非空 runs 同形数组。先完成全部结构校验，再对两侧每个 finding 的规范化 `target`
49	  执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回比较结果；通过后按既有汇总语义生成本次结果。
50	  比较键为规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id`；baseline 键重复、同键 name 冲突、非法
51	  severity/confidence/evidence、重复 run id、字段缺失或多余均返回 400 `invalid_request`（confidence
52	  为 0–100 的非布尔整数，evidence 为非负整数数组）。成功响应仅含 `comparisons` 和 `summary`：
53	  comparisons 先按 baseline 顺序给出同键 `persistent` 或缺失 `resolved`，再按本次汇总首次出现顺序追加
54	  baseline 没有的 `new`；每项只含 `target`、`template_id`、`name`（优先取 baseline）、`status`、
55	  `before`、`after`（两侧为完整汇总项，缺失为 `null`；字段变化不改变状态）。summary 只含
56	  `total_before`、`total_after`、`persistent`、`resolved`、`new` 五个一致整数。空 baseline 可产生
57	  `new`；复测无发现时 baseline 项全部为 `resolved`；同一输入数组顺序稳定。
58	- `POST /v1/attack-chains/plan`：按目标规划攻击链阶段，纯本地处理，不执行阶段、不持久化。请求体仅含
59	  `allow`、`deny`、`findings`、`stages`；`findings` 与 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 数组同形且可为空，
60	  `stages` 为非空数组，每个阶段含非空 `id`（唯一）、`name`、`logic`（`all`/`any`）、非空 `requires`
61	  （每项仅含 `template_id`、`min_severity`、`min_confidence`，后者为 0–100 的非布尔整数）和
62	  `depends_on`（阶段 id 数组，不得重复、自指、引用未知 id 或成环）。先完成全部结构校验（finding 的规范化
63	  `target` 与 `template_id` 组合重复、阶段 id 重复或依赖无效均为 400 `invalid_request`），再对全部
64	  finding 的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部计划。
65	  通过后按规范化 `target` 分组（目标保持首次出现顺序），条件仅匹配同一目标下 `template_id` 大小写一致、
66	  `severity` 与 `confidence` 均达门槛的发现项；阶段按拓扑顺序评估（同层保持输入顺序），自身条件成立且
67	  所有依赖均为 `ready` 时状态为 `ready`（`reason` 为 `null`），条件不成立时为 `skipped` 且原因为
68	  `missing_requirements`，条件成立但依赖未就绪时原因为 `dependency_blocked`。成功响应仅含 `plans`，
69	  每项含 `target` 和覆盖所有阶段的 `stages`（阶段结果含 `id`、`name`、`status`、`reason`）；空
70	  `findings` 返回空 `plans`，相同输入的数组顺序稳定。
71	- `POST /v1/reports/export`：把既有结果导出为单一稳定的证据报告，纯本地处理。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、
72	  `title`、`findings`、`comparisons`、`plans`；`title` 为非空字符串，后三项分别沿用 consolidate、retest 和
73	  attack-chains/plan 的结果项，均为可空数组。先完成结构及交叉一致性校验：以规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的
74	  `template_id` 为键，各数组内不得重复；comparison 的 `status` 仅可为 `persistent`、`resolved`、`new`，
75	  `before`/`after` 的空值位置须符合状态，非空项须与外层键一致；`comparisons` 非空时，非空 `after` 须与
76	  `findings` 的同键项完整一致，且 `findings` 不得有未被比较的当前项；plan 的 `target` 唯一且须存在于当前
77	  findings，阶段 `id` 在单个计划内唯一，`status` 与 `reason` 只能采用 `ready`/`null`、
78	  `skipped`/`missing_requirements`、`skipped`/`dependency_blocked` 三种既有组合；同键出现不同 `name`
79	  也属不一致。上述错误一律返回 400 `invalid_request`。结构校验通过后，对全部 `target` 执行范围评估，
80	  任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回局部报告。成功响应仅含 `report`：`schema_version`
81	  为字符串 `"1.0"`，`title` 原样保留；`summary` 只含 `targets`、`current_findings`、`persistent`、
82	  `resolved`、`new`、`ready_stages`、`skipped_stages` 七个计数；`targets` 为分组报告，目标按 findings
83	  首次出现排序、再追加仅见于 comparisons 的目标，每个目标项只含规范化 `target`、`findings`、`comparisons`、
84	  `stages`。计数从实际内容计算，空输入返回全零 summary 和空 targets，相同输入产生相同结果。
85	- `POST /v1/credentials/analyze`：离线分析凭证观测中的弱口令迹象，不联网、不持久化任何口令，响应与错误
86	  均不回显 `secret` 或 `weak_secrets` 内容。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`attempts`；`policy`
87	  仅含 `min_length`（1–128 的非布尔整数）与 `weak_secrets`（元素唯一的非空字符串数组）；`attempts` 可为空

89	  整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或 `udp`）、非空 `service`、非空 `username`、字符串 `secret`、布尔

91	  返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个尝试的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403

100	  `allow`、`deny`、`target`、`items`；`target` 沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符，`items` 可为空数组。

130	  不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、`policy`、`attempts`；`policy` 仅含 `window_ms` 与
131	  `max_requests`（均为正的非布尔整数）和 `group_by`（仅 `target` 或 `target_route`）；`attempts` 可为空
132	  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、以 `/` 开头的非空 `route`、
133	  非空 `identity` 和非负非布尔整数 `timestamp_ms`，不接受多余字段。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、

149	  先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、依赖未知或重复、自依赖、依赖成环及
150	  非法范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个 `target` 的规范化形式，

161	  整数 `window_ms` 与 `max_actions_per_target`、无重复动作种类的 `blocked_kinds` 数组；`actions` 可为空
162	  数组，每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、沿用既有目标语法且不得为通配符的 `target`、动作种类 `kind`（仅
163	  `discovery`、`verification`、`exploitation`、`credential`、`privilege`）和非负非布尔整数
164	  `scheduled_ms`，不接受多余字段。先完成全部结构校验（字段缺失或多余、类型或数值非法、重复 `id`、
165	  `blocked_kinds` 重复及非法范围规则均返回 400 `invalid_request`；空 `actions` 仍校验 policy 与范围
166	  规则），再按既有 allow/deny 语义检查每个动作的规范化 `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403
167	  `scope_violation`，不返回局部决策。通过后按输入顺序处理：`enabled` 为 `false` 时全部动作以

169	  `target` 计入固定窗口（窗口起点为 `floor(scheduled_ms / window_ms) * window_ms`），每目标每窗口放行
170	  前 `max_actions_per_target` 个，之后以 `action_limit` 阻断，前两类阻断不占配额。成功响应仅含

172	  `scheduled_ms`、`status`、`reason`（`allowed` 时 `reason` 为 `null`，`blocked` 时只能取上述三种

176	## 验证
177	
178	```bash
179	PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
180	```
181	
182	当前基线刻意不包含资产发现、漏洞模板与攻击链编排的实现，以便后续任务从已冻结事实出发独立设计并验证这些能力。

# RedForge

这是一个面向渗透测试与攻防演练的渗透测试与攻防演练平台。长期目标是提供资产发现与指纹识别、端口与服务测绘、漏洞模板匹配、凭证探测、载荷生成、攻击链编排、授权边界强制和结果评分，把攻防演练沉淀为可复用平台。

仓库采用 Python，当前冻结基线只提供进程健康检查。后续能力必须通过独立题目逐步实现；每个题目都应定义可观察的公共行为、兼容边界和失败语义，不得依赖未公开内部 API。

## 启动

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m redforge.server --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
```

服务默认监听 `127.0.0.1:8080`，可通过 `REDFORGE_ADDR` 修改。`GET /healthz` 返回 JSON 健康状态。

## 接口

- `POST /v1/scope/evaluate`：以 `allow`/`deny` 规则评估 `targets` 的授权范围，纯本地判定。
- `POST /v1/vulnerabilities/match`：离线漏洞模板匹配。请求体含 `allow`、`deny`、`templates`、`observations`；
  先对全部观察目标执行范围评估（任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`），再把每个观察与每个模板按
  `all`/`any` 逻辑匹配，响应仅含 `findings`（按观察顺序、再按模板顺序），每项给出 `observation_id`、
  规范化 `target`、`template_id`、`name`、`severity` 和命中匹配器下标 `evidence`。
- `POST /v1/assets/fingerprint`：在本地把端口观测识别为服务资产，不联网、不持久化。请求体仅含 `allow`、
  `deny`、`fingerprints`、`observations`，后两项可为空数组；`observations` 的每项仅含 `id`（唯一非空字符串）、
  `target`（沿用既有目标语法，不得为通配符）、`port`（1–65535 的非布尔整数）、`transport`（仅 `tcp` 或
  `udp`）、`banner`（字符串）。`fingerprints` 的每项仅含唯一非空 `id`、非空 `name` 和 `service`、非布尔整数
  `priority`、值为 `all` 或 `any` 的 `logic`、非空 `matchers`。匹配器只能三选一：仅含 `ports`（无重复的
  1–65535 非布尔整数非空数组）、仅含 `transport`（`tcp` 或 `udp`），或仅含 `operator` 与非空 `value`（针对
  `banner`，operator 仅限 `equals`、`contains`、`regex`）；文本比较区分大小写，`regex` 使用搜索语义，非法
  表达式令请求无效。先完成全部结构校验（结构错误、重复 `id`、或规范化 `target`+`transport`+`port` 相同的重复
  端点均返回 400 `invalid_request`），再对每个观测的规范化 `target` 执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403
  `scope_violation`，不返回局部结果。通过后按 `all`（全部匹配器命中）/`any`（至少一个命中）判定指纹命中，
  多指纹命中时选择 `priority` 最大者，并列选择输入靠前者；evidence 为命中匹配器下标，按下标升序返回。成功响应
  仅含 `assets`：按目标首次出现顺序分组，每项含规范化 `target` 和 `services`；services 保持观测顺序，每项含
  `observation_id`、`port`、`transport`、`service`、`fingerprint_id`、`name`、`evidence`。未命中任何指纹时
  `service` 为 `"unknown"`，`fingerprint_id` 与 `name` 为 `null`，`evidence` 为空数组；空 `observations`
  返回空 `assets`；相同输入内容与顺序产生稳定结果。
- `POST /v1/findings/consolidate`：汇总多次扫描的匹配结果，纯本地处理。请求体含 `allow`、`deny` 和非空
  `runs`；每个 run 有唯一非空 `id`、0–100 的整数 `reliability` 和 `findings`（字段与
  `/v1/vulnerabilities/match` 的单项一致，拒绝未知字段）。先对全部 finding 的 `target` 执行范围评估，
  任一被拒则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`；随后以规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id` 为键去重，
  按首次出现顺序返回 `consolidated`：保留首次出现的 `name`（同键不同 name 为 400），`severity` 取最高者，
  `observation_ids` 与 `sources`（run id）各自按首次出现顺序去重，`evidence` 合并为升序去重的非负整数；
  `confidence` 对包含该键的每个不同 run 按 runs 顺序计算
  `c = c + floor((100 - c) * reliability / 100)`（c 从 0 开始），同一 run 内的重复 finding 只计一次
  置信度，但仍参与观察编号与证据合并。没有 finding 时返回空数组；结构错误一律 400 `invalid_request`。
- `POST /v1/findings/retest`：把一次复测与既有汇总结果比较，纯本地处理。请求体仅含 `allow`、`deny`、
  `baseline`、`retest_runs`；`baseline` 是既有 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 同形数组（可为空），
  `retest_runs` 是非空 runs 同形数组。先完成全部结构校验，再对两侧每个 finding 的规范化 `target`
  执行范围评估，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`，不返回比较结果；通过后按既有汇总语义生成本次结果。
  比较键为规范化 `target` 与区分大小写的 `template_id`；baseline 键重复、同键 name 冲突、非法
  severity/confidence/evidence、重复 run id、字段缺失或多余均返回 400 `invalid_request`（confidence
  为 0–100 的非布尔整数，evidence 为非负整数数组）。成功响应仅含 `comparisons` 和 `summary`：
  comparisons 先按 baseline 顺序给出同键 `persistent` 或缺失 `resolved`，再按本次汇总首次出现顺序追加
  baseline 没有的 `new`；每项只含 `target`、`template_id`、`name`（优先取 baseline）、`status`、
  `before`、`after`（两侧为完整汇总项，缺失为 `null`；字段变化不改变状态）。summary 只含
  `total_before`、`total_after`、`persistent`、`resolved`、`new` 五个一致整数。空 baseline 可产生
  `new`；复测无发现时 baseline 项全部为 `resolved`；同一输入数组顺序稳定。
- `POST /v1/attack-chains/plan`：按目标规划攻击链阶段，纯本地处理，不执行阶段、不持久化。请求体仅含
  `allow`、`deny`、`findings`、`stages`；`findings` 与 consolidate 响应的 `consolidated` 数组同形且可为空，
  `stages` 为非空数组，每个阶段含非空 `id`（唯一）、`name`、`logic`（`all`/`any`）、非空 `requires`
  （每项仅含 `template_id`、`min_severity`、`min_confidence`，后者为 0–100 的非布尔整数）和

def _jcs_string(text: str) -> str:
    """JSON string literal per RFC 8785: minimal escapes, no ASCII folding."""
    parts = ['"']
    for char in text:
        escape = _JCS_ESCAPES.get(char)
        if escape is not None:
            parts.append(escape)
        elif ord(char) < 0x20:
            parts.append(f"\\u{ord(char):04x}")
        else:
            parts.append(char)
    parts.append('"')
    return "".join(parts)


def _jcs_canonicalize(value: Any) -> bytes:
    """Serialize a JSON value to its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical UTF-8 bytes.

    Object keys sort by UTF-16 code unit order; only the JSON types the
    audit chain uses (objects, arrays, strings, integers, booleans, null)
    are supported.
    """
    if value is None:
        return b"null"
    if value is True:
        return b"true"
    if value is False:
        return b"false"
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return _jcs_string(value).encode("utf-8")
    if _is_int(value):
        return str(value).encode("ascii")
    if isinstance(value, list):
        inner = b",".join(_jcs_canonicalize(item) for item in value)
        return b"[" + inner + b"]"
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        members = sorted(
            value.items(),
            key=lambda item: item[0].encode("utf-16-be", "surrogatepass"),
        )
        inner = b",".join(
            _jcs_string(key).encode("utf-8") + b":" + _jcs_canonicalize(item)
            for key, item in members
        )
        return b"{" + inner + b"}"
    raise TypeError(f"cannot canonicalize {type(value).__name__}")

    The record dict must hold every field except ``hash``; the exercise id
    is mixed in so identical event streams under different exercises hash
    differently. Bytes come from the RFC 8785 canonical form.
    """
    obj = dict(record)
    obj["exercise_id"] = exercise_id
    return hashlib.sha256(_jcs_canonicalize(obj)).hexdigest()

"""HTTP entry point for RedForge."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from .service import ScopeViolationError, Service

SCOPE_PATH = "/v1/scope/evaluate"
MATCH_PATH = "/v1/vulnerabilities/match"
FINGERPRINT_PATH = "/v1/assets/fingerprint"
CONSOLIDATE_PATH = "/v1/findings/consolidate"
RETEST_PATH = "/v1/findings/retest"
PLAN_PATH = "/v1/attack-chains/plan"
EXPORT_PATH = "/v1/reports/export"
CREDENTIALS_PATH = "/v1/credentials/analyze"
PAYLOADS_PATH = "/v1/payloads/generate"
ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH = "/v1/sessions/escalation-paths"
RATE_LIMIT_PATH = "/v1/requests/rate-limit-analyze"
SCHEDULE_PATH = "/v1/requests/schedule"
SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH = "/v1/exercises/safety-evaluate"
POST_PATHS = (
    SCOPE_PATH,
    MATCH_PATH,
    FINGERPRINT_PATH,
    CONSOLIDATE_PATH,
    RETEST_PATH,
    PLAN_PATH,
    EXPORT_PATH,
    CREDENTIALS_PATH,
    PAYLOADS_PATH,
    ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH,
    RATE_LIMIT_PATH,
    SCHEDULE_PATH,
    SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH,
)
MAX_BODY_BYTES = 1024 * 1024


def env_address() -> tuple[str, int]:
    raw = os.environ.get("REDFORGE_ADDR", "127.0.0.1:8080")
    host, _, port = raw.rpartition(":")
    if not host or not port.isdigit():
        raise SystemExit(f"invalid REDFORGE_ADDR: {raw!r}")
    return host, int(port)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    service = Service()

    def send_json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def send_error_json(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        self.send_json(status, {"error": {"code": code, "message": message}})

    def not_found(self) -> None:
        self.send_error_json(404, "not_found", f"no route for {self.path}")

    def reject_non_post(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        self.send_error(501, "Unsupported method (%r)" % self.command)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path in POST_PATHS:
            self.send_error_json(405, "method_not_allowed", "use POST for this route")
            return
        if self.path == "/healthz":
            self.send_json(200, self.service.health())
            return
        self.not_found()

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        if self.path == SCOPE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.evaluate_scope)
            return
        if self.path == MATCH_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.match_vulnerabilities)
            return
        if self.path == FINGERPRINT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.fingerprint_assets)
            return
        if self.path == CONSOLIDATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.consolidate_findings)
            return
        if self.path == RETEST_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.retest_findings)
            return
        if self.path == PLAN_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.plan_attack_chains)
            return
        if self.path == EXPORT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.export_report)
            return
        if self.path == CREDENTIALS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_credentials)
            return
        if self.path == PAYLOADS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.generate_payloads)
            return
        if self.path == ESCALATION_PATHS_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.compute_escalation_paths)
            return
        if self.path == RATE_LIMIT_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.analyze_rate_limit)
            return
        if self.path == SCHEDULE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.schedule_requests)
            return
        if self.path == SAFETY_EVALUATE_PATH:
            self._handle_json_post(self.service.safety_evaluate)
            return
        self.not_found()

    def _handle_json_post(self, handler) -> None:
        raw_length = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
        if raw_length is None or not raw_length.isdigit():
            self.send_error_json(
                400, "invalid_request", "missing or invalid Content-Length"
            )
            return
        length = int(raw_length)
        if length > MAX_BODY_BYTES:
            # Do not drain an oversized body; drop the connection instead.
            self.close_connection = True
            self.send_error_json(413, "request_too_large", "body exceeds 1 MiB")
            return
        body = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            payload = json.loads(body)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", f"malformed JSON: {exc}")
            return
        try:
            result = handler(payload)
        except ScopeViolationError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(403, "scope_violation", str(exc))
            return
        except ValueError as exc:
            self.send_error_json(400, "invalid_request", str(exc))
            return
        self.send_json(200, result)

    do_PUT = reject_non_post
    do_DELETE = reject_non_post
    do_PATCH = reject_non_post
    do_HEAD = reject_non_post

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: object) -> None:
        """Silence per-request logging so recorded output stays stable."""


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="redforge.server", description="渗透测试与攻防演练平台")
    host, port = env_address()
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=host)
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=port)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    print(f"RedForge listening on http://{args.host}:{httpd.server_address[1]}", flush=True)
    try:
        httpd.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        httpd.server_close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import hashlib
import json
import threading
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

from redforge.server import Handler
from redforge.service import ZERO_HASH, ScopeViolationError, Service


def make_event(**overrides):
    event = {
        "id": "evt-1",
        "target": "app.example.com",
        "kind": "discovery",
        "outcome": "success",
        "occurred_ms": 0,
    }
    event.update(overrides)
    return event


def build_payload(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com", "10.0.0.0/8"],
        "deny": [],
        "exercise_id": "ex-1",
        "events": [make_event()],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


def canonical_record(exercise_id, record):
    """Independently canonicalize a record (minus hash) per RFC 8785."""
    obj = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "hash"}
    obj["exercise_id"] = exercise_id
    parts = []
    for key in sorted(obj):
        parts.append(json.dumps(key) + ":" + json.dumps(obj[key]))
    return ("{" + ",".join(parts) + "}").encode("utf-8")


def expected_hash(exercise_id, record):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_record(exercise_id, record)).hexdigest()


def build_audit(service, **overrides):
    return service.build_audit(build_payload(**overrides))["audit"]


def verify_payload(audit, **overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com", "10.0.0.0/8"],
        "deny": [],
        "audit": audit,
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


class AuditBuildServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.service = Service()

    def build(self, **overrides):
        return build_audit(self.service, **overrides)

    def test_single_event_chain(self):
        audit = self.build(events=[make_event(occurred_ms=250)])
        self.assertEqual(list(audit), ["exercise_id", "records", "head_hash"])
        self.assertEqual(audit["exercise_id"], "ex-1")
        (record,) = audit["records"]
        self.assertEqual(
            list(record),
            [
                "id",
                "target",
                "kind",
                "outcome",
                "occurred_ms",
                "sequence",

import threading

from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer

from redforge.server import Handler
from redforge.service import ZERO_HASH, ScopeViolationError, Service


def make_event(**overrides):
    event = {
        "id": "evt-1",
        "target": "app.example.com",
        "kind": "discovery",
        "outcome": "success",
        "occurred_ms": 0,
    }
    event.update(overrides)
    return event


def build_payload(**overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com", "10.0.0.0/8"],
        "deny": [],
        "exercise_id": "ex-1",
        "events": [make_event()],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload


def canonical_record(exercise_id, record):
    """Independently canonicalize a record (minus hash) per RFC 8785."""
    obj = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "hash"}
    obj["exercise_id"] = exercise_id
    parts = []
    for key in sorted(obj):
        parts.append(json.dumps(key) + ":" + json.dumps(obj[key]))
    return ("{" + ",".join(parts) + "}").encode("utf-8")


def expected_hash(exercise_id, record):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_record(exercise_id, record)).hexdigest()


def build_audit(service, **overrides):
    return service.build_audit(build_payload(**overrides))["audit"]


def verify_payload(audit, **overrides):
    payload = {
        "allow": ["*.example.com", "10.0.0.0/8"],
        "deny": [],
        "audit": audit,
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return payload

class AuditHttpTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
        cls.port = cls.server.server_address[1]
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()

    def request(self, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
        url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}{path}"
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, method=method, data=body, headers=headers or {}
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
                return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
            status, payload = exc.code, json.loads(exc.read())
            exc.close()
            return status, payload

    def post_build(self, payload):
        return self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/audit/build", json.dumps(payload).encode()
        )

    def post_verify(self, payload):
        return self.request(
            "POST", "/v1/audit/verify", json.dumps(payload).encode()
        )

    def test_build_ok(self):
        status, payload = self.post_build(
            build_payload(
                events=[
                    make_event(id="a", occurred_ms=100),
                    make_event(id="b", occurred_ms=200),
                ]
            )
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(list(payload), ["audit"])
        audit = payload["audit"]
        self.assertEqual(audit["exercise_id"], "ex-1")
        self.assertEqual(len(audit["records"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(audit["records"][0]["previous_hash"], ZERO_HASH)
        self.assertEqual(
            audit["records"][1]["previous_hash"],
            audit["records"][0]["hash"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(audit["head_hash"], audit["records"][1]["hash"])

    def test_build_empty_events_ok(self):
        status, payload = self.post_build(build_payload(events=[]))
        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(
            payload,
            {
                "audit": {
                    "exercise_id": "ex-1",
                    "records": [],
                    "head_hash": ZERO_HASH,
                }
            },
        )

    def test_verify_round_trip_ok(self):

                    make_event(id="a", occurred_ms=100),
                    make_event(id="b", occurred_ms=200),
                ]
            )
        )

        self.assertEqual(status, 200)
        self.assertEqual(list(payload), ["verification"])
        self.assertEqual(
            payload["verification"],
            {
                "valid": True,
                "checked": 2,
                "head_hash": built["audit"]["head_hash"],
                "failure": None,
            },
        )

  allow/deny 语义检查每个事件的规范化 `target`，任一越界则整体返回 403 `scope_violation`。成功响应
  仅含 `audit`：`exercise_id` 原样保留；`records` 按输入顺序保留事件并写入规范化 `target`，再追加从
